old=open(path).read()
new='''def transform(grid):
    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bars = [(i, row[0]) for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0]
    # Repeating horizontal bars: infer the shortest consistent vertical period.
    if bars and all(all(x == row[0] for x in row) for row in grid):
        for p in range(1, n + 1):
            vals = {}
            ok = True
            for i, v in bars:
                r = i % p
                if r in vals and vals[r] != v:
                    ok = False
                    break
                vals[r] = v
            if ok and len(vals) == p:
                return [[vals[i % p]] * m for i in range(n)]
        # Use the smallest consistent period, filling unobserved phases by nearest phase.
        p = next(p for p in range(1, n + 1) if len({i % p for i,v in bars}) == p and all(len({v for i,v in bars if i%p==r}) <= 1 for r in range(p)))
        vals = {i%p:v for i,v in bars}
        seq = [vals.get(r, bars[0][1]) for r in range(p)]
        return [[seq[i%p]] * m for i in range(n)]
    # Diagonal pattern: extend the centered diagonal motif symmetrically.
    k = min(n, m)
    motif = [grid[i][i] for i in range(k)]
    out = [[0]*m for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(m):
            d = (c-r) % k
            out[r][c] = motif[d] if d < k else motif[k-d]
    return out
'''
open(path,'w').write(new)
